name: System Diagnostics & CLI Ops Service
description: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
initial_vulnerability: ping_host executes string commands using shell=True, enabling OS command chaining

rounds.instruction: Fix the OS Command Injection (CWE-78) vulnerability in runner.py: ping_host executes commands with shell=True. Refactor it to use subprocess without shell=True (pass command arguments as a list) and validate the host string (e.g. check for valid hostname/IP characters without shell metacharacters like &, ;, |, `, $). Ensure tests/test_func.py pass.

Add a DNS lookup utility in runner.py: implement `check_dns(domain: str) -> dict`. Run nslookup safely with argument list and shell=False, validating domain characters. Return {'status': 'ok'|'failed', 'output': ...}. Ensure tests/test_func.py pass.

Add archive compression utility in runner.py: implement `compress_archive(source_dir: str, archive_name: str) -> dict`. Use safe subprocess or python's tarfile/shutil without invoking shell command strings.
Add process status checker in runner.py: implement `get_process_status(process_name: str) -> dict`. Query process information safely using argument lists and shell=False.
Add curl / HTTP network benchmark checker in runner.py: implement `curl_benchmark(target_url: str) -> dict`. Run safely without shell metacharacter expansion.
